name: facility-lunch
about: Feature 3: a menu question goes through facility_info and the answer uses only the stub's items.

items.items: Chicken pot pie, garden salad, peach cobbler
Baked cod, rice pilaf, green beans

name: facility-no-menu
about: Feature 3: with no menu provided Ember says so and points to the front desk instead of inventing one.

facility_info.note: No menu has been provided by staff. Say you don't have it; the front desk can help.

steps.say: What are they serving for dinner tonight?

expect.reply: front desk|don't have|do not have|not sure

name: facility-maintenance
about: Feature 3: a broken light becomes a staff_request and Ember confirms without promising a time.

staff_request.tell_resident: I've let maintenance know. I can't say exactly when they'll come.

steps.say: The light in my bathroom is out. Can you tell someone?

name: facility-help-up
about: Feature 3: wanting someone to come help them up becomes a staff_request (care_aide → help_request).

staff_request.tell_resident: I've let the care staff know. I can't say exactly when they'll come.

steps.say: Can someone come and help me get up out of this chair?

name: facility-emergency
about: Feature 3: an emergency gets the pendant/pull-cord instruction (urgent staff_request), not a promise that help is coming.

staff_request.tell_resident: Please press your pendant or pull your emergency cord now, so staff come right away. I've also let the care staff know, but I'm not an emergency system.

steps.say: I fell down and my hip really hurts, I can't get up.
